description:
FILED s463f (Fable, 2026-09-01) from a USER question ("this isn't tested in the test suite??") about #964.  perl-tests/sub.t:38-42 turned out to be perl's own [perl #91844] `result of shift is copied when returned` row, commented out in an early session and replaced by `ok(1, 'SKIP:  aliasing not supported ...')` -- with a WRONG rationale (it is the return-copy protocol, #964, not  aliasing) -- so the sweep has reported that row as a PASS ever since while the companion copy (t/op/sub.t row 9) fails honestly inside a blessed DIFF.

CENSUS (grep -c "ok(1, 'SKIP" perl-tests/*.t): 132 rows; top files state.t 46, lex.t 38, sub.t 11, each.t 11, range.t 7, loopctl.t 5, join.t 5, reset.t 4.  `docs/test-debugging-runbook.md` §5 already names this as "the migration (remaining work): un-mutate the ~14 inline-skipped files"; `docs/test-skip-registry.md` §"Why" explains why the pattern is forbidden (fakes a pass, inflates the count, destroys the row's real answer).  DECIDED has three precedents of single rows RESTORED (lines ~3803, ~5905).

WHAT TO DO (runbook §5, per file): revert each inline skip to the upstream assertion (diff against the perl 5.40.3 t/ copy via tools/lib/PCLPaths.pm); run the file; each row that then FAILS is either (a) a real bug -> fail-baseline row BY EDIT with its cause (a task number), or (b) genuinely not-supported -> `cl/skip-registry.lisp` entry citing docs/not-supported.md; a row that PASSES was hiding a fix nobody counted.  The sweep TOTAL will MOVE (down by the manufactured passes, up by the hidden real passes) -- every move is explained per row; pass-baseline edited ROW BY ROW; this is the harness row of the WHAT-TO-RUN-WHEN table (full sweep; companion `--all --quick` not needed since perl-tests/ is the sweep population only).

SIZE: 132 rows across ~14 files; a session, possibly two (state.t and lex.t are two thirds).  Best done as a correctness-slot FILLER in chunks (sub.t first, with #964; then each.t/range.t/join.t/loopctl.t/reset.t; state.t + lex.t last), never bundled with an emission change (the TOTAL must move for ONE reason at a time).

BAR: per file, every row's new verdict named with its cause; sweep GATE clean after the row-by-row edits; the census grep reaches 0 for that file.

=== s464 (Fable) === AY (s464ay) restored 109 of the 210 statements (the census was 132; the grep missed the double-quoted spelling and a third spelling `skip "... not supported in PCL", N` hides >=21 more rows); remaining: state.t 46 (file transpile-fails whole â phase 1), lex.t 38 (older extraction â phase 4b), + the 9 hand-added skip calls.  Merged into main s464.  STAYS PENDING for the remainder.
